user_question: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a GeoPackage polygon dataset representing census tracts covering State College.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census tract polygon dataset covering the State College area. Do not assume suitability beyond the returned metadata.

workflow_steps.title: Clip census tracts to State College boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict the retrieved census tract polygons to the supplied State College boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the retrieved census tract GeoPackage polygons using the supplied State College boundary GeoPackage. Preserve the tract attributes and output a GeoPackage polygon layer.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate mean elevation for each State College census tract using elevation data at the requested 30-meter resolution and the available coarser raster.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean zonal elevation for every polygon in state_college_census_tracts using input_2 as the required 30-meter elevation raster. Also process input_1 as the available 90-meter raster so both supplied elevation artifacts are used and reported in the CSV summary. Preserve tract identifiers where available.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.

input_datasets.description: GeoTIFF raster file(s) and optional GeoPackage polygon zone layer.

operation.description: Explicit operation (zonal_statistics, raster_calculator, resample, clip, reproject_raster).

resolution.description: Target pixel resolution in meters for resampling.

target_crs.description: Target coordinate reference system for raster reprojection.
